description.value: The Salty Woodsman is a specialty shop founded in 2020 by a local couple in Port Alberni, stocking handpicked local and frozen seafood, small-batch pantry provisions, snacks, and drinks alongside gifts, clothing, and home goods from local artisans and makers. Set in a forested location en route to the west coast, it describes itself as a destination stop and 'Port Alberni secret' for travelers passing through the Alberni Valley. Cyclists will find provisions including frozen seafood, condiments, candies, coffee, tea, and preserves.

address.value: 4691 Dundalk Ave S., Port Alberni, BC V9Y 8P2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and shows recent Instagram activity from May 2026, confirming the business is open. However, every page of the website prominently announces 'Our new address is A4-4691 Dundalk Ave. South,' with the About and Contact pages listing '4691 Dundalk Ave S., Port Alberni, BC V9Y 8P2' — this clearly supersedes the OSM address of 5161 River Road. The shop sells frozen seafood, pantry items, snacks, coffee, tea, condiments, and preserves alongside gifts and clothing, supporting the Groceries category as a partial fit, though no cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records '5161 River Road, V9Y 6Z2' but the website prominently announces a new address of 'A4-4691 Dundalk Ave. South, V9Y 8P2' on every page — the OSM record needs updating to the current location. The contact page retains the old River Road address in what appears to be a legacy map embed, but the operating address is now 4691 Dundalk Ave S.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open specialty food and gift shop with food provisions useful to cyclists passing through Port Alberni en route to the west coast.
